text:
priya: morning team. quick topic: we promised customers a better "burst behavior" story. i'd like to decide between (A) token-based preheat credits + smoothing, or (B) fixed soft-burst multiplier + carryover. need shipping plan for GA.

tom: quick take: preheat credits model maps better to customer expectations (they think in requests/tokens). more infra work but cleaner billing.

anya: runtime concerns: preheat requires tracking per-tenant credit balance and an async prewarm path for KV caches. costs: extra memory for per-tenant metadata + periodic reconciliation. smoothing (exponential decay) is straightforward in serving.

leo: product POV: customers like predictability. proposal: combine both: give each reserved pool a tiny preheat bucket (token credits) and apply smoothing on top so spikes don't immediately blow the bucket. that gives a front-line buffer plus automatic smoothing.

kate: sales/legal: need simple contract language. "preheat credits" sounds technical; prefer "burst credits" with clear reconciliation rules. also customers want an escape hatch to opt-out of opportunistic preheat.

priya: rough spec suggestion to decide on: 
- GA feature set: pool-level burst credits (initial: 100k tokens per pool per hour) + exponential smoothing window (alpha=0.2)
- Billing: charges only for sustained overage > 1h; short bursts consume credits first, then bill at overage rate if credits exhausted
- Opt-out: tenant flag to disable preheat (traffic always served from pinned capacity)
- Fallback: on 95p latency > 2x baseline for 5m, route affected traffic to pinned lanes and reduce smoothing alpha to 0.05 (faster decay)
- Telemetry: surface burst credits used, token QPS, KV-miss-rate, tail-latency per-tenant

anya: runtime suggestion: implement token credits as a leaky-bucket counter per pool. smoothing implemented client-side in router by low-pass filtering QPS into effective demand. that keeps kernel change minimal.

tom: implementation ETA: basic credits + leaky-bucket accounting + telemetry: 2 sprints. smoothing and router policy tweaks: 1 sprint. opt-out + billing integration: 1 sprint (legal now needs text).

kate: i'll get contract language ready. suggested blurb: "Burst credits are short-term allowances intended for transient traffic spikes. Sustained usage beyond credits will be billed or require reserved capacity." i'll loop in finance.

leo: open question: credit sizing. 100k tokens/hr is a placeholder. can we derive defaults from median customer QPS & typical sequence lengths?

priya: yes, we'll run a sizing job on last 30 days telemetry and propose defaults. action: ana + infra to run query.

cs-bot: ticket CREATED: PROD-5001 "Dedicated: burst-credit preheat + smoothing GA scope" assigned to @tom

tom: noted PROD-5001. I'll split into subtasks: accounting, router smoothing, telemetry, opt-out flag, billing hook.

anya: one more runtime safety: add a circuit-breaker that when KV-miss-rate > threshold AND tail latency rising, we immediately disable preheat for the pool for 10m and emit an alert to oncall.

leo: agree. also add a soft cap on carryover: credits can roll up to 3x hourly allocation but not more. prevents unlimited accumulation.

priya: decision for GA (vote): ship burst-credit accounting + smoothing + opt-out + telemetry; defer fine-grained carryover rollups and billing reconciliation dashboard to GA+1. owners: tom (infra), anya (runtime), kate (contracts), leo (defaults & sizing), priya (product). all thumbs?

anya: thumbs up.

kate: thumbs up. will share contract draft by end of week.

tom: thumbs up, will start PROD-5001 planning.

priya: thanks. i'll update roadmap and put a gating note: GA must include telemetry + opt-out or we don't turn on preheat by default. follow-up sync 3pm PT.
